theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 15 群

items.pos: v. 歡迎 | adj. 受歡迎的
items.colloc: welcome to + 地點 歡迎來到... | warm welcome 熱烈歡迎
items.distinct: invitation 邀請函 | reception 接待
ex: We welcome your feedback on the new policy.
我們歡迎您對新政策提供回饋。
The new intern is a welcome addition to the team.
這位新實習生是團隊中受歡迎的一員。
Please feel free to welcome our guests.
請隨時歡迎我們的訪客。

items.colloc: leave of absence 請假 | in the absence of 在缺乏...的情況下
items.distinct: shortage 短缺 | vacancy 空缺
ex: Her absence from the meeting was noted.
她未出席會議一事已做記錄。
The project failed in the absence of clear goals.
由於缺乏明確目標，該專案失敗了。
Please report any extended absence to HR.
請向人資部門報告任何長時間的缺勤。

items.colloc: acceptable level 可接受水準 | make it acceptable 使其合適
items.distinct: accessible 可進入的 | exceptional 例外的
ex: This quality is not acceptable for our clients.
這種品質對我們的客戶而言無法接受。
We need to find an acceptable solution soon.
我們需要儘快找到一個可行的方案。
The current proposal is quite acceptable to us.
目前的提案對我們來說相當合適。

items.colloc: report accurately 準確報告 | measure accurately 精準測量
items.distinct: precisely 精確地 | correctly 正確地
ex: The report must accurately reflect the data.
報告必須準確地反映數據。
Can you accurately predict the sales figures?
你能準確預測銷售數字嗎？
She described the situation very accurately.
她非常準確地描述了當時的情況。

items.colloc: adequately prepared 準備充分 | adequately trained 受過適當訓練
items.distinct: sufficiently 足夠地 | properly 適當地
ex: The staff was not adequately trained for this.
員工沒有受過適當訓練來處理此事。
Please ensure you are adequately prepared for the talk.
請確保您已為演講做好充分準備。
The system is adequately funded this year.
該系統今年的資金相當充足。

items.colloc: employment agency 就業服務處 | advertising agency 廣告代理商
items.distinct: department 部門 | organization 組織
ex: The advertising agency handles our marketing campaigns.
這家廣告代理商負責我們的行銷活動。
They signed a contract with a recruitment agency.
他們與一家招募機構簽署了合約。
The travel agency offered a discount for groups.
該旅行社提供團體折扣。

items.colloc: aggressively market 積極行銷 | aggressively expand 積極擴張
items.distinct: actively 主動地 | assertively 自信地
ex: The firm is aggressively expanding into new markets.
該公司正積極擴張至新市場。
We must price our products more aggressively.
我們必須更積極地調整產品定價。
The competitor is aggressively seeking new talent.
競爭對手正積極尋求新人才。

items.pos: v. 接近；處理 | n. 方法；途徑
items.colloc: take an approach 採取方法 | approach a deadline 接近截止日期
items.distinct: method 方法 | procedure 程序
ex: We need a fresh approach to this problem.
我們需要針對這個問題採取新的方法。
The deadline for the project is fast approaching.
該專案的截止日期即將到來。
Management will approach the issue next week.
管理層下週將處理這個問題。

items.colloc: news article 新聞報導 | write an article 撰寫文章
items.distinct: essay 論說文 | column 專欄
ex: I read an interesting article about global trade.
我讀了一篇關於全球貿易的有趣報導。
The article highlights the benefits of remote work.
該文章強調了遠距工作的優點。
Every article in the store is on sale.
店內所有商品都在特價。

items.colloc: assure someone of 讓某人確信 | rest assured 請放心
items.distinct: ensure 確保 | insure 投保
ex: I can assure you that the order is safe.
我可以向您保證訂單很安全。
The manager assured the team of his support.
經理向團隊保證會給予支持。
Please rest assured that we will fix it.
請放心，我們會解決這個問題。

items.pos: n. 作者；作家 | v. 撰寫
items.colloc: best-selling author 暢銷作家 | author a report 撰寫報告
items.distinct: writer 作家 | editor 編輯
ex: The author of the manual is the chief engineer.
這本手冊的作者是總工程師。
She authored a book on corporate leadership.
她寫了一本關於企業領導的書。
The report was authored by the research department.
該報告由研發部門撰寫。

items.colloc: checked baggage 託運行李 | baggage claim 行李領取處
items.distinct: luggage 行李 | equipment 設備
ex: Please keep your baggage with you at all times.
請隨時保管好您的行李。
He left his baggage at the hotel reception.
他把行李留在旅館櫃檯。
The airline lost my baggage during the flight.
航空公司在飛行期間弄丟了我的行李。

items.pos: adj. 化學的 | n. 化學物質
items.colloc: chemical industry 化學工業 | chemical reaction 化學反應
items.distinct: substance 物質 | material 材料
ex: The factory produces various industrial chemicals.
這家工廠生產各種工業化學品。
They are looking for safer chemical alternatives.
他們正在尋找更安全的化學替代品。
Avoid contact with these dangerous chemical substances.
請避免接觸這些危險化學物質。

items.colloc: be conscious of 意識到 | cost-conscious 重視成本的
items.distinct: cautious 謹慎的 | conscientious 認真的
ex: He is very cost-conscious when buying supplies.
他在購買物資時非常有成本意識。
She was conscious of the time during the meeting.
她在會議期間意識到了時間。
The company is conscious of its environmental impact.
該公司意識到了其對環境的影響。

items.colloc: contribute to 導致；對...做出貢獻 | contribute money 捐錢
items.distinct: attribute 歸因於 | distribute 分配
ex: Everyone contributed to the success of the event.
每個人都對活動的成功做出了貢獻。
Poor communication contributed to the project delay.
溝通不良導致了專案延遲。
They contributed funds to the local charity.
他們向當地慈善機構捐了款。

items.colloc: costly mistake 重大錯誤 | costly procedure 昂貴的程序
items.distinct: expensive 昂貴的 | valuable 有價值的
ex: The delay turned out to be a costly mistake.
這次延誤變成了一個代價高昂的錯誤。
Replacing the old machinery is too costly.
更換舊機器的費用太昂貴了。
We should avoid such a costly error again.
我們應該避免再次犯下這種代價高的錯誤。

items.pos: v. 覆蓋；報導；支付 | n. 封面
items.colloc: cover the cost 支付費用 | news cover 新聞報導
items.distinct: include 包含 | wrap 包裹
ex: The insurance policy covers all medical expenses.
這份保險單涵蓋了所有醫療費用。
Can you cover my shift this Friday afternoon?
這週五下午你能幫我代班嗎？
The reporter will cover the global summit live.
記者將現場報導全球峰會。

items.colloc: customs duty 關稅 | clear customs 通關
items.distinct: costumes 服裝 | customer 客戶
ex: Your luggage might be checked at customs.
您的行李可能會在海關被檢查。
We had to pay customs on the imported goods.
我們必須為進口商品繳納關稅。
It took an hour to clear customs yesterday.
昨天花了一個小時才通過海關。

items.colloc: define the scope 定義範圍 | clearly defined 明確定義的
items.distinct: refine 精煉 | confine 限制
ex: The contract clearly defines our responsibilities.
合約明確定義了我們的職責。
Please define the scope of your research project.
請定義您研究專案的範疇。
It is hard to define the company culture.
很難定義這種公司文化。

items.colloc: deliver a speech 發表演說 | deliver goods 運送貨物
items.distinct: distribute 分發 | supply 供應
ex: The courier will deliver the package by noon.
快遞員中午前會送到包裹。
The CEO will deliver a speech at the opening.
執行長將在開幕式上發表演說。
We promise to deliver orders within three days.
我們承諾在三天內送達訂單。
